name: Woodland shrub
description: Original woodland asset; compatible render parts consolidated with triangle, normal, UV, material and rig preservation measured. Owner scene acceptance and GPU performance remain separate.

findings.message: 1 part marked intentionally open (markOpenShell) was not measured as a closed solid. 1 marked "Original double-sided MASK foliage cards; intentional open sheets", because a valid closed solid could not be measured (Not manifold): "Mesh_FoliageSurface". 1 overlapping part pair was not measured because of this part alone; overlap there is not ruled out.

metrics.partVolumeScope: Visible static closed mesh pairs, except alternates on different LOD levels; excludes intra-mesh intersections, motion, open surfaces and usable passage space. Positive overlap may be intentional.

metrics.instanceabilitySummary: B (informational, not a QA verdict), set by 2 distinct materials (B at 2-3). Also: 2 geometries; 2 draw calls.

rules.reason: Neutral measurement adapter remains to be qualified; no category fallback is used.
